name: phusd-history-indexer
description: Scheduled Lambda that indexes Bonfire burns, Antimatter annihilations and discount batch mints from Ethereum mainnet into s3://phusd.behodler.io/history.json.

scripts.build: rm -rf node_modules function.zip && npm install --omit=dev && npm run zip
scripts.zip: zip -r function.zip index.mjs lib package.json node_modules >/dev/null && echo 'Wrote function.zip'
